overall_strategy: Focus on essentials for a 3-month-old, 10 lb, high-activity pug living in an apartment: subscribe to high-frequency consumables (puppy kibble, wet toppers/pouches, multiple sizes of training treats, poop bags, training pads, wrinkle & paw wipes, dental paste, and calming diffuser refills) with math-based frequencies so Thor never runs out during the critical socialization and housebreaking window. Prioritize one-time purchases for safety and durable setup (cooling pad because of the heat warning, harness, bowls, playpen, bed, slow feeder, durable chew toys, nail grinder, clicker, water bottle, visibility light, and an air purifier). This mix minimizes waste (no autoship on long-lasting items), keeps daily operations simple, and protects Thor’s breed-specific needs (heat sensitivity, facial folds, fast eating, strong chewing, and frequent potty trips) while you focus on training and bonding.
